claims.claim: active noise cancellation erases noise by playing an inverted copy of it
claims.definition: the system senses ambient noise and drives the speaker with an equal-and-opposite (anti-phase) signal so the two pressure waves cancel
claims.measured_value: cancellation, not physical blocking; strongest on steady low-frequency sound
claims.authoritative_source: IEEE Spectrum ANC explainers; Bose ANC engineering documentation
claims.notes: principle is textbook; narration stays qualitative

claims.claim: the anti-noise signal is inverted 180 degrees out of phase with the noise
claims.definition: phase inversion flips the waveform so every pressure crest becomes a trough of equal amplitude
claims.authoritative_source: standard acoustics texts (Kinsler et al., Fundamentals of Acoustics)
claims.notes: exact number 180 degrees stated in narration and pop

claims.claim: a wave and its inverse superpose to near-zero pressure (destructive interference)
claims.definition: linear superposition: pressures add; equal amplitude with opposite phase sums to zero
claims.measured_value: residual depends on amplitude/phase match; ideal case is zero
claims.authoritative_source: standard acoustics texts; Britannica destructive interference entry
claims.notes: narration says cancel to still air, not perfect zero everywhere

claims.claim: ANC attenuation is strongest at low frequencies and weakens as frequency rises
claims.definition: long-wavelength low-frequency noise is easier to match in phase and amplitude; high-frequency noise scatters and varies across the ear, so cancellation degrades
claims.measured_value: effective band roughly below 1 kHz; effectiveness declines above it
claims.authoritative_source: published ANC attenuation measurements (RTINGS lab data; Leippert/Studer acoustics notes)
claims.notes: narration stays qualitative: low rumbles die easily, high hiss gets through

claims.claim: a feedback microphone inside the cup measures residual noise and continuously re-corrects
claims.definition: closed loop: inner mic samples what is left after cancellation and the controller keeps updating the anti-noise output
claims.measured_value: continuous closed-loop operation; typical consumer ANC combines feedforward and feedback mics
claims.authoritative_source: IEEE Spectrum ANC architecture explainers; DSP industry documentation

claims.claim: consumer ANC reduces low-frequency noise on the order of 30 decibels
claims.definition: measured attenuation of steady low-frequency noise by modern over-ear ANC headphones
claims.measured_value: roughly 20-30 dB typical for low-frequency steady noise; 'around thirty' is the defensible center
claims.authoritative_source: RTINGS ANC attenuation measurements; manufacturer specs (Bose/Sony) for low-frequency bands
claims.notes: narration says 'around thirty decibels' for engine drone, the best-case band
